policy: Insert only into the physical PUB-9C materialized master. Every marker must attach to an exact supporting sentence or immediately following claim cluster. Never reuse a pre-PUB-9C anchor hash after reader revisions.

classes.externalAuthority: Verified BIB record(s) support an empirical or scholarly claim.
classes.projectSynthesis: Author/project synthesis; do not fabricate an external source.
classes.recordCallback: Reuses earlier established record; add a local callback only if needed for reader traceability.

amendment.claimBurden: Contemporary consciousness science contains competing theories with empirically distinguishable predictions; this does not establish civilization-scale consciousness.

hardStops: Do not insert into a non-materialized PUB-9C master.
Do not convert PROJECT SYNTHESIS into a literature citation.
Do not let a citation imply that civilization is an organism.
Do not let consciousness citations imply that civilization is conscious.
Do not let anticipation literature imply prophecy or conscious foresight.
Do not let frequency language imply mechanism.
Do not let analogy become evidence.
Do not reuse legacy 45-slot exact-anchor hashes.
